data.title: IT shares extend decline to 3rd straight day as Nasdaq gains strength ahead of Anthropic listing
data.description:
Shares of Indian IT companies extended their decline for the third consecutive session on Thursday, even as Nasdaq gained strength ahead of Anthropic's stock market debut.

The sentiment towards IT stocks remained weak amid concerns that expectations of higher US interest rates could affect technology spending by clients. Indian IT companies derive a significant portion of their revenue from the US market.

Minutes of the US Federal Reserve's October meeting showed that policymakers saw the need to step up efforts to contain inflation, although they agreed to keep interest rates unchanged for now.

The Nifty IT index declined more than 2 percent, with nine of its 10 constituents trading in the red. The index has lost more than 4 percent over the past three trading sessions.

Infosys was the biggest laggard, falling up to 3 percent. Mphasis and Tech Mahindra followed, declining 2.27 percent and 2.17 percent, respectively. TCS, HCL Technologies and Wipro also traded lower, losing up to 2 percent.

Meanwhile, Nasdaq 100 futures surged 1.1 percent after Anthropic announced that it had priced its initial public offering (IPO) at USD 83 per share, above the earlier indicated range of USD 70-78. The company's shares were indicated to open 20-26 percent higher in grey market trading.

The gains came after a sharp correction in global equities triggered by concerns over the sustainability of investments in artificial intelligence (AI) and expectations of further interest rate hikes by the US Federal Reserve.

Indian IT segment is often seen as a reverse AI play, as faster adoption of AI by global clients could increase the risk of automation replacing some traditional IT services, potentially affecting demand for services offered by Indian technology companies.

data.title: NetEase Announces Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
data.description:
HONG KONG, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- NetEase, Inc. ( and , "NetEase" or the "Company"), a leading internet and game services provider, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.

Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights

  • Net revenues were RMB27.9 billion (US$4.2 billion), a decrease of 1.8% compared with the same quarter of 2025.
    • Games and related value-added services net revenues were RMB22.9 billion (US$3.4 billion), a decrease of 1.7% compared with the same quarter of 2025.
    • Youdao net revenues were RMB1.4 billion (US$213.1 million), a decrease of 12.3% compared with the same quarter of 2025.
    • NetEase Cloud Music net revenues were RMB1.9 billion (US$290.3 million), a slight decrease of 0.9% compared with the same quarter of 2025.
    • Innovative businesses and others net revenues were RMB1.5 billion (US$229.7 million), an increase of 7.1% compared with the same quarter of 2025.
  • Gross profit was RMB19.0 billion (US$2.8 billion), an increase of 4.8% compared with the same quarter of 2025.
  • Total operating expenses were RMB9.6 billion (US$1.4 billion), a decrease of 5.4% compared with the same quarter of 2025.
  • Net income attributable to the Company's shareholders was RMB8.4 billion (US$1.3 billion). Non-GAAP net income attributable to the Company's shareholders was RMB9.2 billion (US$1.4 billion).[1]
  • Basic net income per share was US$0.39 (US$1.96 per ADS). Non-GAAP basic net income per share was US$0.43 (US$2.13 per ADS).[1]

[1] As used in this announcement, non-GAAP net income attributable to the Company's shareholders and non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per share and per ADS are defined to exclude share-based compensation expenses. See the unaudited reconciliation of GAAP and non-GAAP results at the end of this announcement.

Third Quarter 2026 and Recent Operational Highlights

  • Sustained engagement across established titles, underscoring the lasting appeal of our gaming portfolio. The Fantasy Westward Journey franchise, Identity V, Eggy Party, Sword of Justice and Where Winds Meet continued to captivate diverse player communities through content updates, gameplay innovation and crossover collaborations.
  • Strengthened our global appeal through differentiated gaming experiences and continued content innovation. Marvel Rivals deepened engagement with players worldwide through new features and fresh content, while Where Winds Meet surpassed 100 million players globally in August 2026, highlighting our growing capabilities in game development and live operations for the global market.
  • Advanced our diverse pipeline of games spanning more genres, gameplay experiences and themes. We progressed development and launch preparations for Ananta, which is currently scheduled for a multiplatform global launch on January 15, 2027. We also began rolling out player tests for several other titles in development.

"In the third quarter, we remained committed to delivering thoughtfully crafted game content and nurturing lasting player communities through fresh and compelling experiences," said Mr. William Ding, Chief Executive Officer and Director of NetEase. "While we continue to evolve our established titles with content and gameplay mechanics that appeal to a broader range of players, we are also steadily advancing our titles in development across genres, platforms and markets.

"Looking ahead, we remain focused on bringing together creative vision, technological innovation and strong execution to deliver games that stand the test of time. By continuing to strengthen our development and live operations capabilities, we aim to bring exceptional gaming experiences to vibrant player communities worldwide, creating long-term value for our partners and shareholders," Mr. Ding concluded.

Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

Net Revenues

Net revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB27.9 billion (US$4.2 billion), compared with RMB30.1 billion and RMB28.4 billion for the preceding quarter and the same quarter of 2025, respectively.

Net revenues from games and related value-added services were RMB22.9 billion (US$3.4 billion) for the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB25.0 billion and RMB23.3 billion for the preceding quarter and the same quarter of 2025, respectively. Net revenues from the operation of online games accounted for approximately 97.5% of the segment's net revenues for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 97.7% and 97.6% for the preceding quarter and the same quarter of 2025, respectively. The quarter-over-quarter decrease was primarily due to lower net revenues from certain self-developed games.

Net revenues from Youdao were RMB1.4 billion (US$213.1 million) for the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB1.5 billion and RMB1.6 billion for the preceding quarter and the same quarter of 2025, respectively. The year-over-year decrease was mainly due to decreased net revenues from its smart devices and online marketing services.

Net revenues from NetEase Cloud Music were RMB1.9 billion (US$290.3 million) for the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB2.0 billion each for the preceding quarter and the same quarter of 2025.

Net revenues from innovative businesses and others were RMB1.5 billion (US$229.7 million) for the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB1.6 billion and RMB1.4 billion for the preceding quarter and the same quarter of 2025, respectively.

Cost of Revenues

Cost of revenues for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB8.8 billion (US$1.3 billion), compared with RMB8.9 billion and RMB10.2 billion for the preceding quarter and the same quarter of 2025, respectively. The year-over-year decrease was mainly due to lower revenue-sharing costs.

Gross Profit

Gross profit for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB19.0 billion (US$2.8 billion), compared with RMB21.2 billion and RMB18.2 billion for the preceding quarter and the same quarter of 2025, respectively.

Operating Expenses

Total operating expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB9.6 billion (US$1.4 billion), compared with RMB9.1 billion and RMB10.2 billion for the preceding quarter and the same quarter of 2025, respectively. The quarter-over-quarter increase was primarily due to increased marketing expenses. The year-over-year decrease was primarily due to decreased marketing expenses and general and administrative expenses.

Other Income/(Expenses)

Other income/(expenses) consisted of investment income/(loss), interest income, net exchange gains/(losses) and others. The quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year fluctuations in other income/(expenses) were mainly due to fair value changes of listed equity securities.

Income Tax

The Company recorded a net income tax charge of RMB1.9 billion (US$275.9 million) for the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB2.5 billion and RMB1.3 billion for the preceding quarter and the same quarter of 2025, respectively. The effective tax rate for the third quarter of 2026 was 17.8%, compared with 25.5% and 13.0% for the preceding quarter and the same quarter of 2025, respectively. The effective tax rate represents certain estimates by the Company as to the tax obligations and benefits applicable to it in each quarter.

Net Income and Non-GAAP Net Income

Net income attributable to the Company's shareholders totaled RMB8.4 billion (US$1.3 billion) for the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB7.0 billion and RMB8.6 billion for the preceding quarter and the same quarter of 2025, respectively.

Basic net income was US$0.39 per share (US$1.96 per ADS) for the third quarter of 2026, compared with US$0.33 per share (US$1.63 per ADS) and US$0.40 per share (US$2.01 per ADS) for the preceding quarter and the same quarter of 2025, respectively.

Non-GAAP net income attributable to the Company's shareholders totaled RMB9.2 billion (US$1.4 billion) for the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB7.7 billion and RMB9.5 billion for the preceding quarter and the same quarter of 2025, respectively.

Non-GAAP basic net income was US$0.43 per share (US$2.13 per ADS) for the third quarter of 2026, compared with US$0.36 per share (US$1.80 per ADS) and US$0.44 per share (US$2.22 per ADS) for the preceding quarter and the same quarter of 2025, respectively.

Other Financial Information

As of September 30, 2026, the Company's net cash (total cash and cash equivalents, current and non-current time deposits and restricted cash, as well as short-term investments balance, minus loans) totaled RMB175.2 billion (US$26.1 billion), compared with RMB163.5 billion as of December 31, 2025. Net cash provided by operating activities was RMB10.5 billion (US$1.6 billion) for the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB10.0 billion and RMB12.9 billion for the preceding quarter and the third quarter of 2025, respectively.

Quarterly Dividend

The board of directors approved a dividend of US$0.117 per share (US$0.585 per ADS) for the third quarter of 2026 to holders of ordinary shares and holders of ADSs as of the close of business on December 3, 2026, Beijing/Hong Kong Time and New York Time, respectively, payable in U.S. dollars. For holders of ordinary shares, in order to qualify for the dividend, all valid documents for the transfer of shares accompanied by the relevant share certificates must be lodged for registration with the Company's Hong Kong branch share registrar, Computershare Hong Kong Investor Services Limited, at Shops 1712-1716, 17th Floor, Hopewell Centre, 183 Queen's Road East, Wanchai, Hong Kong, no later than 4:30 p.m. on December 3, 2026 (Beijing/Hong Kong Time). The payment date is expected to be December 14, 2026 for holders of ordinary shares and on or around December 17, 2026, for holders of ADSs.

NetEase paid a dividend of US$0.096 per share (US$0.480 per ADS) for the second quarter of 2026 in September 2026.

Under the Company's current dividend policy, the determination to make dividend distributions and the amount of such distribution in any particular quarter will be made at the discretion of its board of directors and will be based upon the Company's operations and earnings, cash flow, financial condition and other relevant factors.

Share Repurchase Program

On November 20, 2025, the Company announced the extension of its previously approved share repurchase program of up to US$5.0 billion of the Company's ADSs and ordinary shares in open market purchases or other transactions for an additional 36 months until January 9, 2029. As of September 30, 2026, approximately 24.9 million ADSs had been repurchased under this program for a total cost of US$2.3 billion.

The extent to which NetEase repurchases its ADSs and its ordinary shares depends upon a variety of factors, including market conditions. These programs may be suspended or discontinued at any time.

** The United States dollar (US$) amounts disclosed in this announcement are presented solely for the convenience of the reader. The percentages stated are calculated based on RMB.

Conference Call

NetEase's management team will host a teleconference call with a simultaneous webcast at 7:00 a.m. Eastern Time on Thursday, November 19, 2026 (Beijing/Hong Kong Time: 8:00 p.m., Thursday, November 19, 2026). NetEase's management will be on the call to discuss the quarterly results and answer questions.

Interested parties may participate in the conference call by dialing 1-914-202-3258 and providing conference ID: 10058096, 15 minutes prior to the initiation of the call. A replay of the call will be available by dialing 1-855-883-1031 and entering PIN: 10058096. The replay will be available through November 26, 2026.

This call will be webcast live, and the replay will be available for 12 months. Both will be available on NetEase's Investor Relations website at http://ir.netease.com/.

About NetEase, Inc.

NetEase, Inc. ( and , "NetEase") is a leading internet and game services provider centered around premium content. With extensive offerings across its expanding gaming ecosystem, the Company develops and operates some of the most popular and longest-running mobile and PC games available in China and globally.

Powered by one of the largest in-house game R&D teams focused on mobile, PC and console, NetEase creates superior gaming experiences, inspires players, and passionately delivers value for its thriving community worldwide. By infusing play with culture, and education with technology, NetEase transforms gaming into a meaningful vehicle to build a more entertaining and enlightened world.

Beyond games, NetEase's service offerings include its majority-controlled subsidiaries Youdao (NYSE: DAO), an intelligent learning and advertising solutions provider, and NetEase Cloud Music (), a well-known online music platform featuring a vibrant content community, as well as Yanxuan, NetEase's private-label consumer lifestyle brand.

data.title: Jacobs selected by Sanofi to deliver new insulin manufacturing facility in Germany
data.description:
Jacobs () has been selected by Sanofi as the Engineering, Procurement and Construction Management (EPCM) partner for a new insulin manufacturing facility in Frankfurt, Germany.

Located alongside Sanofi’s established insulin manufacturing campus, the facility will support the production of multiple insulin products and strengthen supply reliability.

Jacobs will provide integrated EPCM services spanning design, procurement, construction management and commissioning. Building on its involvement during early project development, Jacobs will leverage existing site infrastructure and advanced manufacturing technologies to deliver a state-of-the-art facility.

Jacobs Executive Vice President Sean Sommer said: "Our life sciences legacy began in 1943, when our founder, Dr. Joe Jacobs, was part of the team that enabled the first commercial-scale production of penicillin. More than 80 years later, we continue to deliver the advanced manufacturing facilities behind some of the world's most important therapies."

The project will incorporate advanced manufacturing systems that support efficient and reliable operations. Jacobs will deploy an integrated team spanning engineering, procurement, project controls, construction management, commissioning, quality and safety to deliver the project from design through startup.

This award further strengthens Jacobs' position as a leading solutions provider to global pharmaceutical and biotechnology manufacturers. Earlier this year, Engineering News-Record (ENR) ranked Jacobs the No. 1 Pharmaceuticals Design Firm, reflecting its leadership delivering advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing and biomanufacturing facilities. For example, Jacobs is providing EPCM services for FUJIFILM Biotechnologies' $3.2 billion Holly Springs campus, one of North America's largest biomanufacturing facilities, underscoring Jacobs' role in delivering complex life sciences investments at scale.

In Germany, Jacobs continues to deliver some of the country's most critical infrastructure and advanced manufacturing investments. Recent work includes SuedLink, one of the world's largest underground high-voltage power cable projects, a framework with TransnetBW supporting Germany's grid expansion and energy transition, and thyssenkrupp Steel's major industrial decarbonization program. With more than 300 employees across three offices in Germany, Jacobs provides integrated solutions spanning life sciences, energy, infrastructure and advanced manufacturing, helping drive innovation, resilience and long-term economic growth.

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow – delivering outcomes and solutions for the world’s most complex challenges. With approximately $12 billion in annual revenue and a team of approximately 47,000, we provide end-to-end services in advanced manufacturing, cities & places, energy, environmental, life sciences, transportation and water. From advisory and consulting, feasibility, planning, design, program and lifecycle management, we’re creating a more connected and sustainable world. See how at jacobs.com and connect with us on LinkedIn, Instagram, X and Facebook.

data.title: Singapore oil product stocks dip to two-week lows
data.description:
By Jeslyn Lerh, Trixie Yap and Mohi Narayan

Singapore's oil product inventories eased to two-week lows as stocks of light and middle distillates fell, though higher residual fuel stocks limited declines, government data showed.

Combined onshore oil product stocks at Asia's key fuel trading hub were at 39.93 million barrels in the week ended November 18, down 1.1% week-on-week, Enterprise Singapore data showed.

LIGHT DISTILLATES AT ABOUT TWO-MONTH LOWS

Light distillate inventories, including naphtha and gasoline, fell to a near two-month low of 10.8 million barrels in the week.

Gasoline imports tanked 69% to 67,000 tons (about 566,000 barrels) during the period, while exports rose about 13% on-week to roughly 459,000 tons. The top supplier was China at about 50,000 tons, while the top destination for exports was Australia at 111,000 tons.

Meanwhile, total naphtha imports rose about 2% week-on-week to around 207,000 metric tons (about 1.9 million barrels).

The top supplier was the United Arab Emirates at about 87,000 tons, followed by the United States at 57,000 tons, while Singapore also exported about 57,000 tons of naphtha in the week.

MIDDLE DISTILLATES EASE WHILE RUSSIAN BARRELS EMERGE

Middle distillate stocks eased to two-week lows of 8.33 million barrels against a backdrop of higher diesel net exports.

For diesel and gasoil, net exports nearly tripled from a week ago while imports were little changed.

Imports from Russia surfaced after a hiatus of several months, with remaining imports mostly from South Korea and Taiwan.

The vessel Rarity discharged mostly high-sulphur gasoil into Singapore tanks within the last two weeks, Kpler data showed.

Exports of diesel and gasoil for the week were mainly to regional destinations such as Australia and Indonesia, though surprise volumes to Turkey were also present.

Meanwhile, net exports of jet fuel and kerosene fell by 22%, despite a decline in total imports. Exports for the week were mostly for Australia, while imports were negligible.

Imports from China totalling 44,000 metric tons (346,000 barrels) in the next few weeks are expected, ship-tracking data showed.

data.title: Toyota to recall over 314,000 US vehicles over Takata air bag rupture risk, NHTSA says

  • Toyota said it has received no reports of ruptures involving the affected inflators, according to the NHTSA recall report

  • The automaker said the inflators were nearing the end of their estimated safe service life and could rupture if a front passenger air bag deploys

  • Toyota said it is conducting the recall out of an abundance of caution, according to NHTSA

  • NHTSA said certain Takata front passenger air bag inflators in these vehicles could rupture due to propellant degradation after long-term exposure to high humidity, high temperatures and high temperature cycling

  • Depending on the vehicle, dealers will replace the front passenger air bag inflator or the air bag assembly free of charge, the agency said

data.title: Japan's Norinchukin posts sixth straight quarterly profit; bond losses swell
data.description:
By Anton Bridge

Japan's Norinchukin Bank [RIC:RIC:NORB.UL] recorded a net profit of 81.6 billion yen ($511.37 million) in the July-September quarter, it said on Thursday, compared with a net profit of 26 billion yen in the year-ago period.

  • The results mark Norinchukin's sixth consecutive quarter in the black, with profits over the quarter lifted by higher interest income

  • However, higher interest rates globally caused unrealised losses in its bond portfolio to rise to 2.08 trillion yen at end-September from 1.24 trillion yen six months earlier

  • The jump in unrealised losses principally derived from bonds Norinchukin already held rather than recent new purchases, Chief Financial Officer Masaki Nagano said at a press briefing

  • The unlisted bank is still shoring up its finances after its holdings of US and European sovereign bonds fell in value when interest rates rose in 2022, ultimately forcing writedowns and an annual net loss of $12.63 billion in the year ended March 2025

  • While it has sought to steadily sell down its bond portfolio and diversify through investments in equities and private assets, its 43.5-trillion-yen market investment portfolio remains dominated by bonds and credit, which together make up 93% of the total

  • Norinchukin is the main financial institution for Japan's farming, forestry and fishery cooperatives and generates returns primarily through investments rather than lending.

data.title: ANT Stock’s Debut Could Be A Blockbuster – But SpaceX And SK Hynix History Shows Why The First-Day Pop Isn’t Everything
data.description:
Key points:
  • Gray market insights suggest that investors were still lining up to buy the stock.
  • Mega listings this year, including SpaceX and SK Hynix, have mostly disappointed new shareholders.
  • Anthropic stock will begin trading on Thursday under the ticker ‘ANT.’

Anthropic PBC’s shares are expected to open between 20% and 26% higher in gray market trading, Bloomberg reported on Thursday, another bullish signal of breakneck demand for the AI firm’s shares after its record $107.3-billion initial public offering (IPO).

Derivatives offered by online brokerage IG International pointed to a market value of $1.35 trillion on Thursday morning in Hong Kong, implying a gain of more than 24% from the IPO price of $83, according to the report. Anthropic-tied perpetual futures contracts listed on the crypto platform Hyperliquid traded at around $100, a 20% premium to the IPO price.

Anthropic on Wednesday said it sold shares at $83 apiece, sharply higher than the $70 to $78 range it indicated earlier. The IPO was reportedly oversubscribed seven times and received bids worth about $500 billion.

The gray market insights suggest that investors were still lining up to buy the stock on Thursday, when it begins trading on Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker ‘ANT.’

A potential first-day rally in ANT would further allay concerns about global AI demand and cement Anthropic’s status as an AI bellwether. Still, doubts remain about whether Anthropic will have an easy ride in the near future.

Anthropic IPO: Challenge Ahead

Mega listings this year, including SpaceX (SPCX) and SK Hynix (SKHY), have mostly disappointed new shareholders, according to a Morningstar analysis.

SpaceX began trading at $150 a share, an 11% premium to its offering price, in June. In the 110 trading days since SpaceX’s record-breaking IPO, shares have closed below $150 on 74 occasions. SpaceX has spent more than 50% of its time as a public company, or 60 days, trading below its opening price.

SK Hynix and Cerebras (CBRS) also currently trade well below their IPO price.

The sheer amount of new stock available to public investors is likely hindering performance, according to Ben Inker, co-head of asset allocation at GMO. Historically, “when you got a lot of supply in the form of IPOs, that tended to harm the market,” he said, according to Morningstar.

SK Hynix’s ANT Stake Swells 16 Times

Bloomberg reported that SK Hynix unit SK Telecom’s investment in Anthropic generated nearly 16-times returns and is now worth $3.2 billion. The company first invested in 2023. SK Hynix and rival Samsung Electronics are also investors in Anthropic.

For Samsung and SK Hynix, the upside is supply. Anthropic’s prospectus names the two Korean chipmakers along with Micron as the primary manufacturers of the high-bandwidth and other high-performance memory used in AI infrastructure.

In an explainer earlier this week, Stocktwits detailed Anthropic’s major backers who stand to benefit from its IPO.

Anthropic’s IPO Details, Retail View

Anthropic issued 801.3 million new shares and selling shareholders sold 23.6 million shares in the IPO. The company priced the sale at $83 apiece on Wednesday, raising a total of $107.3 billion, including $26 billion through a private placement.

On Stocktwits, the retail sentiment for ANT was at nearly the highest mark in the ‘extremely bullish’ zone (98/100), with traders speculating that the stock would surely touch $100 on Thursday.

data.title: Singapore’s MAS issues $77 million in tokenized bills settled via CBDC
data.description:
The Monetary Authority of Singapore announced Thursday that it issued S$100 million ($77.5 million) of four-week tokenized MAS Bills on Nov. 6, as the country steps up its tokenization drive.

In a statement released Thursday, the central bank said the bills were issued natively on its Singapore Dollar Test Network and settled in wholesale central bank digital currency (CBDC). The bills will mature on Dec. 4.

Notably, five primary dealers — DBS Bank, HSBC, OCBC, UOB, and Standard Chartered — participated in the auction, which drew applications more than twice the issuance size.

The issuance builds on the 2025 live trial of interbank overnight lending transactions settled via wholesale CBDC. "This paves the way for secured lending transactions involving tokenized assets to take place on the Singapore Dollar Test Network," the MAS said.

The Singapore Dollar Test Network is a shared ledger infrastructure that enables financial institutions to test the settlement of tokenized financial assets using wholesale CBDC, according to the statement. It will be renamed to SG Digital Ledger, the MAS said.

"The live issuance allowed us to test a new method of issuance, and further enhance our in-house distributed ledger infrastructure," said Chia Der Jiun, Managing Director of MAS.

Scaling tokenized bills

In the next phase, the MAS plans to scale tokenized MAS Bills, expand their use for collateral management, and onboard more institutions.

"MAS aims to demonstrate how tokenized securities can be used more widely in mainstream financial market activities, potentially achieving greater settlement efficiencies in the process," said the central bank.

In an accompanying statement released Thursday, Lim Soon Chong, group head of global transaction services at DBS Bank, said that the initiative has provided "greater confidence" for financial institutions to transact in tokenized assets.

"Over time, more robust infrastructure can help catalyze trading activity and deepen liquidity, supporting the progression of tokenized assets from issuance and experimentation toward more active secondary markets," said Lim.

Tokenization push

The issuance comes as Singaporean financial institutions accelerate their adoption of tokenized assets, with MAS' Chia saying that tokenization has "moved beyond experiments."

On Thursday, Standard Chartered announced an expansion of its tokenized deposits solution to enable near real-time transactions across Singapore and Hong Kong. The bank said eligible clients can now utilize commercial bank deposits within digital treasury and investment workflows.

Meanwhile, StraitsX, OCBC, and Standard Chartered said Thursday that they have completed a proof-of-concept testing interoperability between tokenized deposit networks issued by different banks.

Earlier this week, DBS Bank and Kinexys by JPMorgan also launched an interoperability solution designed to enable institutions to make instant, around-the-clock transfers of USD tokenized deposits between the U.S. and Singapore.

data.title: Bitcoin ETF assets fall to three-month low as 2026 net outflows top $2.5B
data.description:
US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) ended Wednesday with $77.7 billion in net assets, a three-month low, as net outflows for the year topped $2.5 billion.

BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) held the most Bitcoin, with about 779,870 BTC, followed by the Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC) with 172,080 BTC and Grayscale Bitcoin Trust (GBTC) with 122,730 BTC.

Bitcoin briefly dipped below $63,000 on Wednesday. It traded at $63,545 at publishing time, down 1.7% over the past 24 hours, according to CoinGecko.

Vikram Subburaj, CEO of crypto exchange Giottus, said in a statement shared with Cointelegraph that institutional selling and expectations of tighter US monetary policy continued to weigh on market sentiment.

He also cited onchain data showing that long-term Bitcoin holders had reduced their positions by around 121,151 BTC over 30 days.

Selling pressure also extended to US spot Ether (ETH) ETFs, which recorded around $40 million in outflows Wednesday, bringing their 2026 net withdrawals to roughly $895 million.

data.title: Energean profit jumps 54% on higher oil prices as Katlan project stays on track
data.description:
The Israel-based Eastern Mediterranean gas producer said net profit for the nine months to Sept. 30 rose to $317m from $206m a year earlier. The increase was driven by a 44% rise in realised liquids prices to $88 a barrel, reflecting stronger oil market conditions during the period.

Operational performance remained solid, with average production of 139,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day (kboed), in line with the company's guidance. Adjusted EBITDAX rose 7% to $888m, while production costs excluding royalties fell 10% to $193m, supporting profitability.

Energean maintained its production outlook for the full year of 130-140 kboed and said the Katlan offshore gas development in Israel remains on track to deliver first gas in the first half of 2027. Total development expenditure for the project is expected to be around $1.25bn, with the company having secured a $700m 10-year loan to support financing.

The London-listed group also reaffirmed its commitment to shareholder returns, declaring a third-quarter dividend of $0.10 per share and saying it expects to return about $110m to shareholders in 2026.
